description.text: Program IntroductionThe graduates will be practical specialists who meet the social requirements, are provided with the theory and knowledge on modern administrative science, are skilled in modern information technology and English language, excel in the method of system science and system engineering, work on the construction and management and development of information resources in various fields.Main CoursesAdvanced language programming, object-oriented programming, web application development, principles and applications of databases, analysis and design of management information system, principles of management, accounting, financial management,principles of ERP system, ERP programming, ERP implementation and evaluation, English.Study Duration4 years.Degree AwardedWith necessary credits, those who have passed all the required courses and met the requirements for graduation of the university will be awarded bachelor's degree and diploma.Notes:*Program commences only if 15 students are enrolled ; otherwise you can study Chinese Language/ Pre- University Program/ other bachelor programs.*Although the courses are taught in English, all students are expected to meet HSK 4 (Chinese Language Test) as the minimal requirement for graduation.

duration.text: The Computer Science at Shandong Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application form 2. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.3. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant4. High school's degree certificateGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.5. Transcript of high school6. Physical examination form 7. Non criminal record 8. Bank statement (above 3000USD

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
